podcast.title: Guitar Tech for Tool, Co-founded A Perfect Circle
podcast.body: Billy Howerdel initially worked as a guitar tech for the band Tool. During Tool's downtime, he co-founded A Perfect Circle, a band that features Tool's lead singer, Maynard James Keenan. "Billy Howardale was a guitar tech for tool. When they weren't doing anything he played in a perfect circle featuring tool singer Maynard James Keenan."
